title: Lemonade Change

contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned bool.

statement: A drink costs 5. Customers arrive in the given order and each pays with one bill. Start with an empty register. Return whether every customer can receive exact change using bills already collected.

examples.explanation: The final customer receives one 10 and one 5.
The first customer needs change before any bill is available.
Three 5 bills cover the final change.

hints: Conceptual: Only the cash from earlier customers can be used as change.
Directional: Track the useful denominations separately.
Implementation: For a 20, prefer one 10 plus one 5 when available. Otherwise try three 5s. A 10 always requires one 5.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
